title: GPU-Accelerated Host-Aware Dead-Measurement Detection in Hybrid Quantum--Classical Programs: Full Version
summary: Hybrid programs combine a quantum circuit with a classical host program that consumes measurement outcomes. In such programs, an outcome may be syntactically read by the host but semantically non-contributory: changing the outcome cannot change the returned value. Such outcomes obscure gates that are dead only relative to the host semantics, and are therefore invisible to circuit-local optimizers.
